main.description: List the known repos that hold data in a space (the writer set), each with its DID and custody. A stratos-custody repo also carries its current rev, which this service stores. A pds-custody repo also carries a `host` and `hostSource` when its host can be resolved: an authority-recorded override, or else the member's DID-document #atproto_pds endpoint; both are omitted when neither is found. This is the membership oracle for a space, answered from this service's active enrollments in the space's boundary. It is a Stratos method, not the upstream com.atproto.space.listWriters, and does not take or return what that method does. It is not a member-facing read: callable with inter-service auth (a syncing service, admitted by its own enrolled boundaries) or with a space credential for that space, never with a plain user session.

space.description: The space's URI (at:space/{did}/{type}/{skey}). This is a space URI in the form above; upstream's space-ref format (atproto#5187) is expected to adopt it. Declared as a plain string until @atproto/lexicon supports a matching format. Its space DID must equal this service's DID.

limit.description: Maximum number of repos to return.

errors.name: UnknownSpace
errors.description: The requested space URI is malformed or its space DID does not match this service's DID.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller is not admitted to the requested space (not a member, or the presented credential targets a different space).

did.description: The DID of a repo that holds data in the space.

custody.description: Who hosts and signs this member's repo: 'stratos' when Stratos itself holds and signs it, 'pds' when the member's own spaces-capable PDS does. Always present; an enrollment recorded before custody tracking reports 'stratos'.

rev.description: The repo's current revision (TID). Present only for a stratos-custody member, whose repo Stratos itself stores; absent for a pds-custody member, whose repo lives on their own PDS.

hash.description: Unpopulated by this service: Stratos stores an MST repo, not an LtHash repo, so it never computes the sha256-of-LtHash-state value this field describes upstream. Reserved for a repo host that does.

host.description: The Stratos convention's resolved repo host for a pds-custody member, if resolvable. Absent for a stratos-custody member, and when neither an override nor a DID-document PDS endpoint could be found.

hostSource.description: Which arm of the Stratos host-discovery convention produced `host`. Absent along with `host` when the member is unresolvable.
